analysis.primary: Macro nDCG@10 on the 36 positive seeds, with gain=2**grade-1; Recall@10 and MRR@10 treat grades 1/2 as relevant.
analysis.quality_screen: Report whether max-pairwise nDCG@10 is at least the lexical baseline; not a real-world release certification.
analysis.controls: Four no-related seeds are excluded from positive denominators. Report returned counts and top similarity; no empty-result/score threshold is imposed.
analysis.stress: Eight abstracts include identical administrative boilerplate to stress max-passage aggregation. No labels will be changed after observing scores.

judgment_policy.2: Same primary mechanism/subtopic as seed; paraphrases and translations are intentional.
judgment_policy.1: Same declared broad domain, different primary mechanism/subtopic.
judgment_policy.0: Every other candidate, including isolated controls. Cross-domain biological connections are outside this controlled task.
judgment_policy.method: Labels fixed by authored domain/subtopic definitions before any embeddings or scores; not independent expert judgments.

memory_scope: Whole evaluation process, including CPU model loading/indexing; not MCP serving RSS.
scope: Controlled authored synthetic metadata; no independent expert or real-library relevance judgments.
